image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor standing on a display stand in an indoor setting. The armor includes a breastplate, pauldrons (shoulder guards), faulds (waist armor), gauntlets, and greaves (leg armor). The breastplate is the central focus, featuring a smooth, reflective surface with anatomical contouring. To the left and right foreground, parts of other armor pieces or shields are visible. In the background, there is a wooden cabinet and a framed picture on the wall.
